key_features: 【Wooden Spoon Holder & Spoon Rest】: In contrast with others, our wood spoons comes with a spoon rest and a holder so you can easily rest and neatly store your spoons and spatulas on your counters during cooking and after cooking. There is a leak hole at the bottom of the spoon holder, so don't worry about water accumulation

【Natural Teak Wood】:Our wooden cooking utensils are crafted from natural solid teak wood, which is healthy, safe, and highly durable. Teak features a dense grain structure, exceptional hardness, and excellent resistance to cracking, making it one of the most long-lasting woods — even stronger than silicone or bamboo. Each spoon is hand-sanded multiple times and coated with a food-safe clear lacquer, resulting in a smooth, glossy surface that resists absorbing odors, protects nonstick cookware.

【9-PIECE WOODEN SPOON SET】: This wood kitchen utensils that features all the essential cooking tools including a flat spatula, fried spatula, slotted spatula, kitchen utensil holder, spoons rest, strainer spoon, salad fork, salad spoon, mixing spoon. The set features practical sizes and an ergonomic design, with longer handles that fit comfortably in your hand for a fatigue-free cooking experience. Perfect for a kitchen beginner or a professional chef.

【Easy to Clean & Store】: This wooden spoon set are nonstick, easy to clean with warm water or soapy water by hand, then hang it in the kitchen to dry naturally. There are holes in the handle of each appliance, you can choose to hang it or put it on the cutlery rack, which is very convenient for storage.Plus, the natural wood finish adds a warm, elegant touch to your kitchen.

【After Sales Service】: Wooden Utensil set is perfect for display as souvenir or kitchen decoration, so it is also an ideal gift choice for anyone who likes to cook — perfect for Mother's Day, birthdays, Thanksgiving, Christmas, or any special occasion.
